Details: Quasimorphosis is gradually ceasing to be a mystery. The Hexarchy is trying to maintain the appearance of control: everything unusual is presented as provocations of the Civil Resistance. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent a notification via the SBN that it was going to conduct an orphan asset inspection. In other words, it is ready to attract PMC to take %STATION_NAME% away from the quasimorphs. After our victory, it will declare what happened as its contribution to the restoration of order in the System. Let it say what it want, the main thing is that it will have to invest heavily in us.

Here's what you need to do: walk around %STATION_NAME% and kill as many quasimorphs as possible. Somehow, %VICTIM_NAME% was able to train quasimorphs to linger in physical reality for a long time.

When we leave this place, the smart guys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive and put %STATION_NAME% in order.
